p: begat Bela his firstborn: He continues in the description of the tribe of Benjamin, because his purpose is to set forth the genealogy of Saul.
they removed them to Manahath: Meaning, the inhabitants of the city of Geba.
away: After he had put away his two wives.
fathers: The chief of the tribe of Benjamin, who dwelt in Jerusalem.
Ner begat Kish: Who in 1Sa 9:2 is called Abiel.
Eshbaal: He is likewise called Mephibosheth, 2Sa 9:6.
Meribbaal: He is also called Mephibosheth, 2Sa 9:6.
